title: Jewels of Sri Lanka: Kandy, Bentota and Colombo in Four Days
alt: Elephants bathing in the Maha Oya river at Pinnawala
transport: Private air conditioned car with an English speaking chauffeur guide throughout

stops.name: Kandy
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Standard class hotel on the Mahaweli river outside Kandy

activities.name: Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage
activities.description: A stop on the way up from the airport to watch the resident herd bathe in the Maha Oya river and feed at the sanctuary.

activities.name: Kandy lake drive and Kandyan dance show
activities.description: An evening circuit of the lake followed by a traditional performance of drummers, masked dancers and the closing fire walk.

program.name: Kandy
program.description: One night by the river at Kandy with the elephants on the way and the lake drive and dance show.

stops.name: Bentota
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast and dinner · Deluxe room · 3★ · Deluxe class beach hotel with a pool facing the sea

activities.name: Peradeniya botanical gardens
activities.description: The royal botanical gardens with their orchid house and avenue of palms, on the way out of Kandy.

activities.name: Madu Ganga boat safari
activities.description: A boat through the mangrove islands of the Madu Ganga before check in at Bentota.

program.name: Bentota
program.description: Peradeniya gardens on the way down, then a boat on the Madu River and a night on the beach.

stops.name: Colombo
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast and dinner · Deluxe room · 3★ · Historic harbourside hotel in the Colombo Fort district

activities.name: Full day Colombo sightseeing
activities.description: Galle Face Green, the Gangaramaya temple, the colonial Fort district, the Lotus Tower and the floating market at Pettah.

program.name: Colombo
program.description: A last night in the Fort district with a full day of the capital.

day_titles.1: Arrival in Colombo and on to Kandy
day_titles.2: Gardens, the Madu Ganga and the beach

1: Arrival at Bandaranaike International and private transfer inland
A stop at the Pinnawala elephant sanctuary on the way
Check in at your Kandy hotel in the afternoon
An evening lake drive and the Kandyan dance performance
2: Breakfast, then the Peradeniya Royal Botanical Gardens
A transfer down to the south west coast
A boat safari through the Madu Ganga mangroves
Check in at Bentota for sunset
3: Breakfast and a transfer down the coast to Colombo
Galle Face Green and the Gangaramaya temple complex
The Fort district, the Lotus Tower and Pettah market

expert.name: Aditya
expert.role: Sri Lanka expert at Hi Tours
expert.quote: Kandy, the hills and then the coast. Sri Lanka works best when you let the island cool you down before it warms you up again.
expert.tip: Carry a light sweater for Nuwara Eliya. It sits at nearly 1,900 metres and evenings are surprisingly chilly even in April.

summary: Four days that still feel like a holiday: a night in Kandy with the elephants and the dance show, Peradeniya and the Madu Ganga on the way to a night on the beach at Bentota, and a last night in Colombo.
included: Included: 3 nights in deluxe class hotels with breakfast and lunch or dinner daily; private airport transfers and all road travel in an air conditioned car with chauffeur guide; the Pinnawala elephant sanctuary; Kandy lake drive and Kandyan dance show; the Peradeniya botanical gardens; the Madu Ganga boat safari; a full day Colombo sightseeing tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Sri Lanka ETA visa fees; lunches unless stated; entrance tickets where marked as payable locally; travel insurance; optional excursions; tips and personal expenses.
